scope: New bounded research evaluations only; does not overwrite historical verdicts.

mandatory_gates.name: SOURCE_IDENTITY
mandatory_gates.requirement: Repository, immutable revision, source paths and exact reviewed bytes match; working-tree drift is recorded separately.

mandatory_gates.name: FACTUAL_CORRECTNESS
mandatory_gates.requirement: Every factual proposition reviewed; no critical contradiction, invented API or unsupported runtime guarantee.

mandatory_gates.name: ARCHITECTURAL_CONTEXT
mandatory_gates.requirement: All frozen relevant callers, callees, configuration, dependencies, state, errors and lifecycle covered within declared boundary.

mandatory_gates.name: REQUIRED_COMPLETENESS
mandatory_gates.requirement: Every predeclared mandatory requirement covered; no retrospective narrowing.

mandatory_gates.name: EXAMPLES_AND_TESTS
mandatory_gates.requirement: Execution claims match actual receipts; static checks are labelled static; required examples validated at authorized level.

mandatory_gates.name: BILINGUAL_SEMANTICS
mandatory_gates.requirement: Both required languages convey equivalent propositions, conditions, negations and identifiers.

mandatory_gates.name: DOCUMENTATION_MAINTENANCE
mandatory_gates.requirement: ADD/MODIFY/REMOVE/NO-OP/INCONCLUSIVE supported by separately acquired scope evidence; absence in one file never authorizes REMOVE.

mandatory_gates.name: INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION
mandatory_gates.requirement: Separate source acquisition/verification procedure challenges output and negative controls; identify same-agent limits, never imply independent human review.

mandatory_gates.name: RECOVERABILITY_AND_PROVENANCE
mandatory_gates.requirement: Candidate, frozen criteria, reviewed sources, references, model identity, evaluations and limitations recoverable with verified bindings.

pass_rule: All nine gates PASS, except predeclared justified N/A. Unknown critical evidence is INCONCLUSIVE. Any mandatory FAIL rejects. No critical unreviewed claim.

approval_levels.TECHNICALLY_ACCEPTED: Exact reviewed candidate passes all applicable gates within frozen scope; not publication/training authorization.
approval_levels.PUBLICATION_APPROVED: Technical acceptance plus separately authorized editorial, licensing, confidentiality and publication review.
approval_levels.TRAINING_GOLD_APPROVED: Explicit owner training-use approval of exact example, cleared rights, lineage and evaluation exclusion; never inherited from technical acceptance.

model_readiness.sampling: Freeze diverse family-disjoint evaluation-only task groups, related dependency/revision/translation exclusions, reviewer and sample-size justification before inference. No sufficient independent sample currently established.

independence: Separate verification implementation is procedural independence only. Same-agent semantic judgments are not independent-human approval.
